findings.claim: HubSpot 的平台主要功能由 AWS（北維吉尼亞、法蘭克福）與 Google Cloud（法蘭克福）第三方資料中心承載（FY2021 10-K 文字）
findings.excerpt: We currently serve the majority of our platform functions from third-party data center hosting facilities operated by Amazon Web Services located in northern Virginia and Frankfurt, Germany and Google Cloud Platform located in Frankfurt, Germany.

findings.claim: 2025-10-20 AWS us-east-1 大規模中斷影響 HubSpot 主要基礎設施所在區域，並在 HubSpot 內部任務處理系統引發連鎖問題；HubSpot 啟動可靠度改善計畫
findings.source: HubSpot Product blog: incident report for october 20 2025
findings.excerpt: AWS experienced one of its most severe service disruptions in recent history, affecting numerous services in the us-east-1 region where HubSpot's primary infrastructure operates.

note: 軟體業無實體製造；未查到台灣/中國曝險。單點風險為雲端供應商（AWS us-east-1）集中。
